title: Manager
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Job Summary As a Manager, Software Engineering at NCR VOYIX, you will lead a team of talented software engineers in the design, development, and delivery of innovative software solutions. You will be responsible for fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment, ensuring technical excellence, and aligning team efforts with overall product and business objectives. Job Responsibilities • Lead and mentor a team of software engineers, providing guidance, performance feedback, and opportunities for professional growth. • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, and deployment. • Drive technical vision and strategy for your team, ensuring alignment with NCR VOYIX's architectural principles and long-term goals. • Collaborate closely with product management, architects, and other stakeholders to define project scope, requirements, and timelines. • Ensure the delivery of high-quality, scalable, and maintainable software solutions that meet business needs. • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, promoting best practices in software engineering, code quality, and agile methodologies. • Manage project schedules, resources, and budgets effectively, communicating progress and risks to leadership. • Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews, providing constructive feedback and ensuring adherence to standards. • Stay abreast of emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating and recommending their adoption where appropriate. Job Qualifications • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. • 5+ years of experience in software development, with a strong background in a relevant technology stack (e.g., Java, C#, Python, Go, cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, GCP). • 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing software engineering teams. • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex software projects from conception to production. • Strong understanding of software design patterns, architectural principles, and scalable system design. • Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban). • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills with the ability to motivate and inspire a team. • Ability to balance technical expertise with effective people management and strategic thinking. • Experience with distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud-native development is highly desirable. • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices. This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position

Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job

**EEO Statement**

Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, NCR Voyix employees, or any NCR Voyix facility. NCR Voyix is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes

*“When applying for a job, please make sure to only open emails that you will receive during your application process that come from a* *@ncrvoyix.com email* *domain.”*

title: Senior SAP ABAP / RAP / OData Consultant
description:
**Job Description – Senior SAP ABAP / RAP / OData Consultant (4–8 Years)**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **SAP ABAP Consultant (4–8 years)** with strong expertise in **SAP S/4HANA, Core ABAP 4yrs exp strong exp / RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model), OData, CDS Views, ABAP on HANA, and SAP Fiori**. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise-grade SAP applications using both classical ABAP and modern SAP development frameworks.

The candidate should be capable of independently handling technical development, collaborating with functional teams, and delivering high-quality SAP solutions across implementation, enhancement, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy custom SAP developments using Classical ABAP and ABAP on HANA.
* Develop applications using **RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP)** including Managed and Unmanaged scenarios.
* Develop and expose business services using **OData V2/V4**, Service Definitions, Service Bindings, and EML.
* Design and develop **Core Data Services (CDS Views)** including associations, compositions, annotations, analytical CDS, and VDM architecture.
* Implement RAP business logic using **Behavior Definitions, Behavior Implementations, Determinations, Validations, Actions, Feature Control, and Authorizations**.
* Develop and enhance SAP Fiori Elements applications integrated with RAP services.
* Develop and optimize **AMDP** procedures and HANA-optimized ABAP applications.
* Develop interfaces using **RFC, BAPI, IDoc, ALE, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services**, and SAP Integration technologies.
* Analyze business requirements and collaborate with functional consultants (MM, SD, FI, PP, QM, etc.) to deliver scalable technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide timely resolutions.
* Perform code reviews, performance optimization, and ensure adherence to SAP development standards and Clean Core principles.
* Prepare Technical Specifications, Unit Test Scripts, and Technical Documentation.
* Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

* Managed RAP
* Unmanaged RAP
* Behavior Definition
* Behavior Implementation

* Service Definition
* Service Binding
* EML
* Determinations
* Validations
* Actions
* Feature Control
* Draft Handling
* Deep Insert
* Value Help

* Attachments

**OData & Fiori**

* OData V2/V4
* SEGW
* SAP Gateway
* Fiori Elements
* SAPUI5 Integration

**Performance & HANA**

* AMDP
* ST05
* SAT
* SQL Monitor
* Runtime Analysis

**Integration**

* RFC
* BAPI
* IDoc
* ALE
* REST APIs
* SOAP Web Services

**Development Tools**

* Eclipse ADT
* SAP Business Application Studio (BAS)

**Nice to Have (SAP BTP)**

* Hands-on experience with **SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)**.
* Knowledge of **Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM)** using Node.js or Java.
* Exposure to **SAP Build Apps**, **SAP Build Process Automation**, and **SAP Build Work Zone**.
* Experience with **SAP HANA Cloud**.
* Knowledge of **SAP Event Mesh**.
* Familiarity with **Cloud Foundry** environment and application deployment.
* Understanding of **OAuth, XSUAA, Destination Service, and Connectivity Service**.
* Knowledge of **Clean Core** and Side-by-Side Extension architecture.
* Exposure to **SAP Joule**, **SAP AI Core**, or AI-assisted SAP development.

**Experience**

* **4–8 years** of hands-on SAP ABAP development experience in **SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA**.
* Minimum **1.5 years** of hands-on experience in **SAP RAP** development.
* Strong expertise in **CDS Views, OData, ABAP on HANA, AMDP, and SAP Fiori**.

title: Senior Java Lead Engineer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Business / Organization Overview**
------------------------------------

We are seeking an experienced and visionary **Java Technical Lead (C12)** to join our Enterprise Engineering team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the design, implementation, and architectural evolution of high-throughput, mission-critical enterprise systems. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional architecture, product, and infrastructure teams to build scalable, resilient, and secure microservices and distributed event-driven platforms.

**Role Summary**
----------------

As a C12 Technical Lead, you will combine hands-on technical execution with engineering leadership. You will drive architectural decisions, govern development standards, mentor engineering talent, and deliver end-to-end resilient back-end and distributed messaging solutions. You will champion engineering excellence, modern DevOps practices, and cloud-native containerized delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Technical Leadership & Architecture**
---------------------------------------

* Lead the technical design, system decomposition, and development of mission-critical microservices and event-driven architectures.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure alignment with organizational blueprints, compliance benchmarks, and engineering standards.
* Own technical governance, including architectural reviews, coding standards, automated testing frameworks, and non-functional requirements (resilience, scalability, low latency, fault tolerance).

**Hands-on Engineering & Delivery**
-----------------------------------

* Design and implement robust, high-performance back-end services using **Core Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIs**.
* Build and optimize event streaming and message-oriented middleware patterns using **Apache Kafka** and **IBM MQ / JMS**.
* Architect and tune high-volume data persistence layers across relational databases (**Oracle**) and NoSQL document stores (**MongoDB**).
* Drive containerization and deployment strategies targeting modern enterprise cloud platforms (**ECS / Red Hat OpenShift**).

**Engineering Excellence & Mentorship**
---------------------------------------

* Conduct rigorous code reviews, enforce unit/integration test coverage standards, and eliminate technical debt.
* Mentor and coach junior and mid-level developers, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Lead root-cause analysis (RCA) and performance troubleshooting for complex production incidents and distributed system bottlenecks.

**Agile & DevOps Collaboration**
--------------------------------

* Drive end-to-end CI/CD automation, shift-left security (SAST/DAST, dependency scanning), and containerized deployments.
* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and Business Stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum delivery model to translate complex business requirements into clear technical roadmaps and epics.

**Required Qualifications & Technical Skills**
----------------------------------------------

  
  

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* **Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree** in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related discipline.
* **10+ years** of total software engineering experience, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or module lead capacity.
  

  

**Primary (Core) Skills & Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* **Core Java & Frameworks:** Deep expertise in Java (Java 11 / 17 / 21), Concurrency, Multithreading, JVM internals, Memory Management, and Garbage Collection tuning.
* **Spring Ecosystem:** Comprehensive experience with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Cloud).
* **API & Integration:** Extensive experience designing and developing RESTful Web Services, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and contract-driven API patterns.
* **Messaging & Event Streaming:** Strong hands-on implementation experience with **Apache Kafka** (producers, consumers, partitions, fault handling) and enterprise message queues (**IBM MQ / JMS**).
* **Database Engineering:** Relational: **Oracle DB** (complex SQL, PL/SQL, schema design, index tuning, transaction isolation). NoSQL: **MongoDB** (data modeling, indexing strategies, aggregation pipelines, performance tuning).
* **Design Patterns & Clean Code:** Strong grounding in SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Distributed Transactions, Sagas, and Microservices design patterns.

**Secondary Skills & Familiarity (Highly Desirable)**
-----------------------------------------------------

* **Containerization & Platforms:** Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms such as **ECS / Red Hat OpenShift**.
* **Frontend / Full-Stack Exposure:** Familiarity with modern frontend development using **Angular**, React JS.
* **Business Process Management:** Exposure to enterprise workflow engines such as **IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / BPM**.
* **Application Servers & Middleware:** Understanding of legacy or hybrid runtime environments including **IBM WebSphere Application Server (WAS / Liberty)**.
* **CI/CD & DevOps:** Working knowledge of modern deployment pipelines, Jenkins/Tekton/Harness, Git, Maven/Gradle, and code quality tools (SonarQube, Snyk).

**Leadership & Behavioral Competencies**
----------------------------------------

* **Problem Solving:** Exceptional analytical and debugging skills with a proven track record of resolving complex distributed systems challenges.
* **Communication:** Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate technical tradeoffs to non-technical business partners.
* **Ownership & Drive:** Demonstrated ability to independently lead engineering initiatives from ideation to production rollout.
* **Collaboration:** High team spirit and emotional intelligence to work across globally distributed engineering teams.

title: Senior Specialist, Technical Coordination
description:
**Senior Specialist, Technical Coordination**

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs.

**ROLE DESCRIPTION SUMMARY**

Facilitates Agile software development processes to ensure smooth and efficient software development cycles. Acts as a servant-leader to the development team by removing impediments, fostering collaboration, and promoting continuous improvement. Coordinates sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Works closely with Software Architects, Tech Leads, developers, QA, Release manager and other stakeholders to align project goals and ensure timely delivery of high-quality software products.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES / KEY RESULT AREAS**

* Schedule and facilitate Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives)
* Provide clear visibility and reporting on project and sprint progress to stakeholders
* Track demand and project implementation for single or multiple teams
* Represent the team in program-level meetings and cross-team coordination
* Act as the main point of contact for team and project-related issues
* Manage Azure DevOps tickets and ensure user story information is complete and up to date
* Shield the team from external disruptions to maintain focus and productivity
* Monitor and track progress of user stories and tasks throughout the sprint
* Coordinate with release management for smooth deployment and delivery processes

**COMPETENCIES**

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and conflict resolution skills
* Ability to identify and remove impediments to ensure smooth team progress
* Proactively identifies ways to contribute to the team and wider SES goals. Shows the ability to motivate self, complete tasks and achieve goals.
* Accountability: holds self and others accountable for individual and team results. Accepts responsibility for mistakes. Uses resources in an efficient way. Shows honesty and truthfulness
* Ability to work autonomously as well in collaboration with other members of the team with minimal supervision with a commitment to KPI`s
* Service and customer-centric mindset
* Openness for new technologies, ability to learn them quickly, and readiness for change.
* Ability to work in a rapidly changing environment under tight timelines.
* Fluent in spoken and written English; additional languages are an asset

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
* Strong understanding of Agile principles, Scrum framework, and other Agile methodologies
* Hands-on experience working as a Scrum Master or Agile Coordinator in a software development environment, facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing cross-functional teams
* Prior experience as a software developer or working closely with development teams to understand technical workflows and challenges
* Experience with Agile project management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira, Trello)
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

* Familiarity with software development lifecycle and release management processes

title: Manager
description:
Job Description: Lead data engineering strategy across multiple projects and teams. Drive innovation in data engineering practices and model optimization. Represent the data engineering team in executive meetings. Develop long-term plans for data engineering and data infrastructure.

  

**Responsibilities: Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to design, build and unit test applications on ***Spark framework on Python*** .
* Build ***Python and PySpark*** based applications based on data in both ***Relational (Oracle, SQL Server) and NoSQL database e.g. Redis, Valkey***
* ***Build ingestion pipelines to load data into in-memory caching database.***
* Build ***data pipeline*** **s** to load and export data to/from the ***Master Data Management or Reference Data Management*** Platform using ***PySpark***
* Hands on experience doing at least one MDM implementation using ***TIBCO, Informatica, GoldenSource*** or ***custom-built MDM/RDM platforms***
* Experience with designing/building ***Data APIs*** and its interaction with data consumers
* Optimize performance of the built Spark applications using configurations around ***Spark Context, Spark-SQL and Data Frame*** .
* Build ***Python programs*** using module libs e.g. ***pandas, requests, json, flask, pickle***
* Experience in processing large amounts of ***structured*** data, including integrating data from multiple sources.
* Ability to design & build real-time applications using ***REST API, JSON, XML***
* Ability to build solutions on AWS services using Glue ETL, Lambda functions on Python
* Create and maintain integration and regression testing framework on ***Jenkins*** integrated with ***BitBucket*** and/or GIT repositories
* Participate in the ***agile development*** process, and document and communicate issues and bugs relative to data standards in ***scrum meetings***
* Work ***collaboratively*** with onsite and offshore team.
* Develop & review technical ***documentation*** for artifacts delivered.
* Ability to solve ***complex data-driven*** scenarios and triage towards defects and production issues
* Participate in ***code release*** and production deployment.
* Challenge and inspire team members to achieve business results in a fast paced and quickly changing environment

  

**Qualifications: Requirements**

* BE/B.Tech/ B.Sc. in Computer Science/ Statistics, Econometrics from an accredited college or university.
* ***Minimum 4 years*** of extensive experience in design, build and deployment of ***PySpark-based*** applications.
* Hands-on experience in **Redis, Valkey, OpenSearch** database
* In-depth knowledge of ***Python*** core programming language – lists, dictionaries, tuples
* Expertise on Python libraries e.g. ***pandas, requests, json, flask, pickle***
* Good understanding on ***Informatica PowerCenter*** for building data pipelines
* Understanding of Master Data Management processes & domain is preferred.
* Hands-on experience writing complex ***SQL queries*** , exporting, and importing large amounts of data using utilities.
* Ability to build ***abstracted, modularized reusable*** code components.
* Hands-on experience in generating/parsing ***XML, JSON*** documents, and ***REST API*** request/responses
* Hands-on experience in **Redis, Valkey, OpenSearch** database
* Able to quickly adapt and learn.
* Able to jump into an ambiguous situation and take the lead on resolution.
* Able to communicate and coordinate across various teams.
* Are comfortable tackling new challenges and new ways of working
* Are ready to move from traditional methods and adapt into agile ones
* Comfortable challenging your peers and leadership team.
* Can prove yourself quickly and decisively.
* Excellent communication skills and Good Customer Centricity.
* Strong Target & High Solution Orientation.

title: Project Manager -Scrum Master - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Job Summary**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven professional to perform a hybrid role of **Project Manager, and Scrum Master**. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, drive project delivery, facilitate Agile practices, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, leadership skills, and hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 7\-10 years of experience in project manager experience.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive and problem\-solving techniques
* Proven interpersonal, diplomatic and influencing skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication

**Professional Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
* PMI\-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner)

**Education:**


* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Job Summary  

  

As a Senior Software Engineer at NCR VOYIX, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software solutions that drive our innovative products and services. You will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and secure applications.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

* Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of robust and scalable software applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to define requirements and deliver solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance and code reviews.
* Contribute to architectural discussions and decisions, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring optimal system performance and reliability.
* Implement best practices in software development, including continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), and automated testing.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating and recommending their adoption where appropriate.
* Document technical designs, specifications, and procedures clearly and concisely.

  

Job Qualifications  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 0\-2 years of professional experience in software development.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C\#, Python, or Go.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and microservices architecture.
* Expertise in designing and implementing RESTful APIs.
* Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).
* Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
